FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 28
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Ed Oliver
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/05/2025
House Bill 28 as introduced would increase the obligations of the State General Fund,
beginning in fiscal year 2026, by $152,858 for each state death benefit payment paid to a
surviving beneficiary or dependent of a coroner, deputy coroner, medicolegal death investigator
or medical examiner that dies in the line of duty.
